options.name: Suspension of the Ila Heksareksoi patriarch
options.desc: Due to the secession of the Isle of Six Kings its patriarch's political rights in the Hexarchy have been suspended.

options.name: Ila Heksareksoi patriarch substituted
options.desc: The seat in the Hexarchy once occupied by the patriarch of the Isle of Six Kings has been given to another regional patriarch.

options.name: Ila Heksareksoi patriarch in the Hexarchy
options.desc: The Archpatriarch has removed the suspension of the patriarch of the Isle of Six Kings.
